EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, by virtue of the powers vested in meby Section 4 of the Commission of Inquiry Act, (Chapter 393) do hereby once again enlarge the period of time up to 30thJune 2019 further considering the current role of the commission, for rendition of the final report on completion of thetasks of the “Presidential Commission of Inquiry established by me on 31st January 2018 in terms of the provisions ofSection 2 of the aforesaid Act by Notification published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2056/41 dated 02nd February,2018 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka to investigate and inquire into alleged irregularities in connectionwith Sri Lankan Airlines Ltd., Sri Lankan Catering Ltd. and Mihin Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd. during the period 01st January 2006 to31st January, 2018”, having enlarged the six month period ending 31st July 2018 granted for the said purpose by fivemonths i. e., up to 31st December 2018 by virtue of the powers vested in me by notification published in the GazetteExtraordinary No. 2082/3 dated 31st July 2018 and again up to 15th February 2019 by virtue of the powers vested in meby notification published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2099/40 dated 30th November, 2018 and yet again up to 30thMay 2019 by virtue of powers vested in me by notification published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2109/18 dated07th February, 2019.
